env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build -o $WORK/hole$GOEXE ./g/nil
cd ..
! exec $WORK/hole$GOEXE
stderr 'panic: own nil receiver'
! stderr 'logos: nil from Go value'
cd w
logos build ./l/...
cd ..
cd w/g
logos build -o $WORK/leak$GOEXE ./cmd
cd ../..
exec $WORK/leak$GOEXE
stdout '^leak hole ok$'

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/c/c.lgo --
package c

type T struct{}

func (t *T) M() string {
	if t == nil {
		panic("own nil receiver")
	}
	return "ok"
}

var PrimesData = []int{2, 3, 5}

func Primes() const []int { return PrimesData }

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

require example.com/l v0.0.0

replace example.com/l => ../l

-- w/g/nil/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/l/c"

func main() {
	var t *c.T
	t.M()
}

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"example.com/g/q"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(q.Run()) }

-- w/g/q/q.go --
package q

import "example.com/l/c"

func Run() string {
	v := c.Primes()
	v[0] = 99
	if c.Primes()[0] != 99 {
		return "leak blocked"
	}
	return "leak hole ok"
}
